correctness.rationale: For every deterministic x in [0,1], the exact Gaussian sign orthant identity gives captured Bayes variance as a two-fold arcsine kernel integral. Log-time differentiation yields dV(e^{-r})/dr=e^{-2r}(C-G(r))/pi with C=pi(2log2-1)/4 and strictly increasing unbounded G(r)=H(2r)-2H(r), proving unique global optimality including endpoints; the closed risk formula and numerical constants are checked by a standalone reproducible verifier and independent convergent series with tail bound. The proof does not rely on finite scans.

value.rationale: Positive-sojourn time is a canonical nonlinear path-integral target; the exact unique one-reading design improves captured variance from 61.37 percent at terminal sensing to 79.57 percent, and selects a time neither the endpoint nor the pathwise reconstruction midpoint. The exact global optimization and risk formula resolve a motivated sparse numerical-integration information problem, not a routine numerical-table calculation.
